title: Alpine Corporation Floating Spray Fountain (FTC102)

comparisons.notes: New condition, UPC 821559008343, Alpine FTC102 48-LED floating spray fountain, 3 available.

writeup: Alpine's FTC102 floating spray fountain, new, is $55.99 at Woot. It floats on a pond and runs a 398 GPH pump with 48 red, white and blue LED lights. Home Depot lists the same model at $108 and an in-stock eBay seller wants $148.88, so this is roughly half off the going rate. Woot shows only 1 left, limit 3 per customer.
